blocks.text: Insan bohat purane zamane se apni rozana zaruraton ke liye natural resources (qudrati wasail) se faida uthata aaya hai. Sab se purane materials lakri, metals aur janwaron se milne wali cheezein hain, jaise kapre. Aabadi bohat barh gayi aur natural resources mehdood (limited) hain, is liye insan ki zaruratein poori karne ke liye naye materials aur machines chahiye thein. Is se bohat se materials ijad hue: metal alloys se nanomaterials tak, aur bare electric cells se bohat achhi chhoti batteries tak. Aaj ki machines, jaise computers, mobiles, construction machinery aur aircraft, sab modern materials aur energy devices ko mila kar banti hain.

Kitab ki Figure 31.1 mobile phone ki tasveer hai. Is mobile mein kai metals, plastic, un ke composites (do ya zyada materials ka milap) aur aik chhota lekin bohat achha energy device hai, yani Li-ion (lithium-ion) battery.
Yeh chapter batata hai ke modern materials aur energy sources (energy ke zariye) mein chemistry ka kya kirdar (role) hai.

Is mein metals, alloys, polymers aur ceramics jaise materials ki tayyari (preparation), properties (khoobiyan) aur uses parhenge, aur un ko check karne ke analytical techniques (jaanch ke tareeqe) bhi, jaise X-ray crystallography. Chapter kuch ahem definitions bhi deta hai: energy density, specific energy aur energy source ki efficiency (kaarkardagi), maslan fossil fuel, nuclear aur solar energy. Phir energy ke istemal ke environment (mahol) par asraat batata hai. Aakhir mein sustainable energy sources (aise zariye jo lambe arse tak chal sakein), jaise photochemical energy devices, ki baat hai.

blocks.prompt: Mobile phone mein kis qism ke materials hote hain, aur us ka energy device kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation: Metals, plastic aur un ke composites; energy device Li-ion (lithium-ion) battery hai.

items: Aabadi barhne aur mehdood resources ki wajah se naye materials aur energy devices bane.
